prior_importants.description: The critical-area check compares only tree(pin) with tree(head). It does not compare what the merge commit landed with what merging the pin there would have landed. A head on an older base can bring back a critical-area change that the target reverted after the pin, and no --approved-by is asked for.
After a re-gate, the remeasure holds a flag to the first gate's figures. The ledger never records the larger figure the re-gate accepted, so a merge no worse than the re-gated pin refuses.
